prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph, camera high and tilted steeply down onto a snowy suburban footpath at night, a lone street lamp glowing at the top edge of the frame among bare trees and power lines. In the upper middle of the frame, a large clean circle has been trodden into the fresh snow by one careful ring of overlapping boot prints, packed firm and pale, its inner field untouched. Inside the ring, up and to the right of centre at about two o'clock, sits one small red plastic triangular reflector with rounded corners, flat edge on top, point down, catching the lamp light. A single line of boot prints leads away from the ring toward the lamp. The lower third is smooth unbroken snow. Deep navy sky, sodium glow, quiet and cold.

Vertical 9:16 night photograph looking steeply down at a snow-covered city pavement outside dark shopfronts, warm amber light from a lamp on a pole spilling across the snow, a few bollards and the edge of a kerb at the top of the frame, fine flakes falling. In the upper middle, a perfectly round raised ring of snow has been pushed up with a shovel blade, a clean low ridge with soft shadow on its inner side. Inside it, upper right of centre at about two o'clock, a small triangle of bright red powder has been sifted onto the snow through a stencil, rounded corners, flat edge on top, pointing down, its edges slightly feathered. A few scattered footprints near the top; the lower third is a plain even sheet of snow. Shop signs dark and unlettered. Quiet, cold, still.

Vertical 9:16 close photograph straight down onto flat, fresh, granular snow, crisp crystals glinting, soft cool daylight with one shadow drifting in at a lower corner. In the upper two thirds, a clean circle has been pressed into the snow with a gloved fingertip, a smooth rounded groove of even width with compacted, slightly glassy walls, the snow inside it left pristine. Inside the circle, upper right of centre at about two o'clock, lies one small red rounded triangle, a plectrum, flat edge on top, point down, a few crystals resting on it. One faint glove print sits just outside the ring at the top edge. The lower third is plain sparkling snow with nothing on it. Real macro texture, pale grey-blue tones, hushed and cold.

Vertical 9:16 photograph from close to overhead onto soft rolling snow drifts at dusk, deep blue shadows lying in the hollows, the last pale light glazing the crests with sparkle. On a broad smooth crest in the upper middle of the frame, a clean circle has been cut into the snow with the tip of a stick, a narrow crisp trench whose shaded inner wall gives the ring a sharp blue edge. Inside the circle, upper right of centre at about two o'clock, sits one small translucent piece of red-dyed ice shaped as a rounded triangle, flat edge on top, pointing down, glowing faintly against the blue. The lower third is untouched drifting snow with gentle wind ripples. Cold blue palette, silent, last light.
